title: AZETIN: The Last Healer
tagline: Only the mirror tells you who is dead.
description: Your 4x4 breaks down at night in front of Azé-tin, a West African village cursed since a fuel station exploded during a festival. The villagers smile, offer you food… but in your rear-view mirror, they are ash. Survive the night, uncover the chief's secret, and choose: flee, betray, or become the last healer. First-person survival horror with 4 endings.
